message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build and upload to PyPI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    tags:
      - xraylib*

jobs:
  build_wheels:
    name: Build wheels on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, windows-latest, macos-15-intel, macos-15]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      # https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/3342#issuecomment-2206538745
      - name: Install swig on macOS
        if: startsWith(matrix.os, 'macos')
        run: brew install swig
      - name: Build wheels
        uses: pypa/cibuildwheel@v4.2.1

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: cibw-wheels-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ strategy.job-index }}
          path: ./wheelhouse/*.whl
          retention-days: 1

  build_sdist:
    name: Build source distribution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Build sdist
        run: pipx run build --sdist

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: cibw-sdist
          path: dist/*.tar.gz
          retention-days: 1

  # publish-to-testpypi:
  #   name: Upload to TestPyPI
  #   needs: [build_wheels, build_sdist]
  #   runs-on: ubuntu-latest

  #   environment:
  #     name: testpypi
  #     url: https://test.pypi.org/p/xraylib

  #   permissions:
  #     id-token: write  # IMPORTANT: mandatory for trusted publishing

  #   steps:
  #     - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
  #       with:
  #         # unpacks all CIBW artifacts into dist/
  #         pattern: cibw-*
  #         path: dist
  #         merge-multiple: true
  #     - name: Publish distribution 📦 to TestPyPI
  #       uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@v1.14.2
  #       with:
  #         repository-url: https://test.pypi.org/legacy/

  publish-to-pypi:
    name: Upload to PyPI
    needs: [build_wheels, build_sdist]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/p/xraylib
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/xraylib')
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          # unpacks all CIBW artifacts into dist/
          pattern: cibw-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Publish distribution 📦 to TestPyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@v1.14.2
",
  "rationale": "The build_sdist job runs `pipx run build --sdist` on every run, which re-fetches build dependencies declared in pyproject.toml (meson-python, Cython, ninja, numpy). The retrieved dependency-cache evidence (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE and the pip-cache experiment) shows caching dependency downloads keyed on the dependency manifest reduces CI job time while preserving all build/check coverage. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip before the sdist build reuses downloaded packages across runs. This is a minimal, additive change: no steps are removed, no permissions are weakened, no secrets/publishing/deployment operations are added, and no new external network access is introduced (actions/cache uses GitHub's native cache service).",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
